recipe.name: Eggs Benedict
steps: For the sauce, melt the butter in a small saucepan on medium-low. In a bowl to the side, beat the egg yolks and add lemon juice, heavy cream, and salt and pepper to taste
Add butter a spoonful at a time, stirring well between. When no butter remains, pour mixture back into saucepan and cook on low for half a minute, whisking constantly. Take off of heat and set aside.
For the eggs, fill a meduium pot with three inches water and bring to boil, then reduce heat to simmer and add a splash of vinegar.
Gently crack and an egg, taking care to ensure that yolk and white do not separate or break.
Let egg cook for three to five minutes, then remove with slotted spoon. Repeat for each egg.
While eggs are cooking, slice and fry canadian bacon to desired crisp, then set on english muffin.
Place sauce onto bacon, then top with egg
